label: Coherent
provenance: ORCHAV saved primary RD products; range-power sum only, no signal reprocessing
provenance_scope: Plotting reads saved primary RD power and sums range only. Creation of the derived sequential recording is described separately under source_lineage.
comparison_receipt_scope: SHA256 of the retained external raw plotting receipt; all comparison source identities and observation windows are embedded below.
authored_configuration_scope: Current tutorial configurations are documentation references. The source_lineage and comparison_sources fields identify the actual recordings; no equivalence between the historical hop1 acquisition and the current native-hop64 scenario is asserted.
command: python -m shared.sensing.plotting.doppler_summary --source Coherent recordings/marching_person/coherent-maps --source Sequential recordings/marching_person/sequential-derived-hop64 --output analysis/marching-person-motion/separate --axis velocity --time-reference midpoint --layout separate
path_convention: The command and comparison source paths use portable logical recording names in place of machine-local evidence directories. They identify converted coherent and derived sequential recordings, not newly generated current-scenario recordings. The raw producer receipt hash retains the original execution-path evidence.

coherent.scope: Saved numerical products retained exactly; no new ray tracing or acquisition.

sequential.scope: 125 existing complete source acquisitions selected at hop64 and replayed from saved CFR. Source acquisition hop1 and pulse memberships are preserved. Primary RD, range profile, delay/frequency power and primary/raw saved STFT match the selected original products exactly. No new ray tracing; these are not newly acquired native-hop64 frames.

timestamp_match: Every saved sample epoch; at most 8 float64 epsilon units at the time scale, no nearest-time selection
public_receipt_scope: Figure, scenario, settings and scientific provenance; historical execution locations and internal campaign records are omitted.
